अरे भाई साहब! Munna Bhai और Circuit की जोड़ी फिर से बड़े पर्दे पर तहलका मचाने की तैयारी में है! 🎬✨

Variety India की एक रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, डायरेक्टर Rajkumar Hirani साल 2027 में Munna Bhai 3 की शूटिंग शुरू करने की योजना बना रहे हैं। खबर है कि राइटर Farhad Samji इस वक्त फिल्म की स्क्रिप्ट पर काम कर रहे हैं। Samji साल 2003 की सुपरहिट फिल्म Munna Bhai M.B.B.S. के मशहूर गाने 'M Bole Toh' से भी जुड़े रहे हैं।

फिल्म में Sanjay Dutt एक बार फिर Munna Bhai और Arshad Warsi उनके जिगरी Circuit के रूप में नजर आ सकते हैं। हालांकि, मेकर्स या एक्टर्स की तरफ से इस शूटिंग शेड्यूल की अभी कोई आधिकारिक पुष्टि नहीं हुई है। 🍿

डायरेक्टर Rajkumar Hirani और Arshad Warsi पहले भी कह चुके हैं कि बिना एक मजबूत कहानी के वे इस फ्रेंचाइजी को आगे नहीं बढ़ाना चाहते थे। Arshad के मुताबिक फिल्म की 3 अधूरी स्क्रिप्ट्स पहले से मौजूद थीं।

क्या आप Munna Bhai 3 में इस आइकॉनिक जोड़ी को फिर से देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.text:
The long-awaited third instalment of the Munna Bhai franchise may finally be moving towards production. After years of speculation surrounding the sequel, a new report suggests that filmmaker Rajkumar Hirani has taken a step forward with the project by bringing writer Farhad Samji on board. The film is reportedly expected to go on floors in 2027, although the production timeline is yet to receive official confirmation.
According to a report by Variety India, Farhad Samji is currently working on the screenplay for Munna Bhai 3 and is expected to complete the script soon. Interestingly, Samji has been associated with the franchise since its first instalment, Munna Bhai M.B.B.S ., which was released in 2003. He had written the opening refrain of the film's popular song ‘ M Bole Toh ’.
The upcoming film is expected to bring back Sanjay Dutt as Murli Prasad Sharma, popularly known as Munna Bhai, alongside Arshad Warsi as his close friend and companion, Circuit. The duo became widely recognised for their on-screen chemistry in the first film and reprised their roles in the 2006 sequel, Lage Raho Munna Bhai . While the first film revolved around Munna's journey into the medical world, its sequel explored Gandhian philosophy through humour and the protagonist's unconventional approach to life.
Despite the audience's continued interest in another instalment, Rajkumar Hirani has maintained that he does not want to move ahead with the film without a storyline that lives up to the previous two movies. Speaking to Hindustan Times in June, the filmmaker had opened up about the difficulty of developing the sequel and said, “If you only want to see Munna Bhai up to the interval, I can make five films right now. Because I don't have the story beyond that point.”
Arshad Warsi had also spoken about the challenges surrounding the third film, revealing that three incomplete scripts already exist. According to the actor, these drafts contain interesting scenes and ideas but lack the central connection required to bring the narrative together.
If the reported production schedule moves ahead as planned, Munna Bhai 3 could bring Sanjay Dutt and Arshad Warsi back together on the big screen nearly two decades after Lage Raho Munna Bhai . However, neither the makers nor the actors have officially confirmed the filming schedule or release date.
For now, the development of the screenplay remains the next important step, with audiences awaiting an official announcement about the return of Munna Bhai and Circuit.
